body.zh: 新华/人民日报仍为9月5日18时指挥部：43死、519失联、2人获救。应急管理部9月17日合计562人死亡失踪，不替代分项。外交部9月24日仍为261名外籍失联。尼方主KPI仍用NDRRMA约9月26日：1453死、5285失联、13795获救。警28日与30日报道1454具遗体，未替代获救总数。堰塞湖已排空。G216仅救援。口岸关闭。本轮无新美使馆公路通告。勿与中方相加。
body.en: Xinhua/People's Daily still command-centre as of 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MEM 17 Sep combined 562 does not replace the split. MFA 24 Sep still 261 foreign missing. NP main KPI remains NDRRMA around 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Police 28 Sep and 30 Sep reports cite 1454 bodies, no new rescued total. Lake drained. G216 SAR-only. Gate closed. No new US Embassy road notice this run. Do not add CN.
body.ne: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 562 jodai, split hoina. MFA 261. NP NDRRMA ~26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795. Police 1454 deha, rescued naya chaina. Tal khali. G216 uddhar matra. Gate band. Naya US road notice chaina. CN najodnu.
body.hi: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 562 jod, split nahi. MFA 261. NP NDRRMA ~26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795. Police 1454 deh, rescued naya nahi. Jheel khali. G216 kewal SAR. Gate band. Naya US road notice nahi. CN na joden.

body.zh: 分县遗体统计已发；1334具已处置。未公布获救总数。安置1283人。COP主KPI仍用NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795。勿与中方相加。
body.en: District body counts posted; 1334 bodies managed. No rescued total. 1283 in shelters. COP main KPI remains NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795. Do not add CN.
body.ne: Jilla hisab; 1334 deha. Rescued total chaina. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN najodnu.
body.hi: Zila hisab; 1334 deh. Rescued total nahi. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN na joden.

body.hi: 112 pehchane. Naya rescued nahi. DNA lagbhag 3685.

body.en: 1453 dead, 5285 missing; about 1109 in 21 centres (805 Rasuwa). 25-28 Sep rain report lists no new Rasuwa casualties.

body.hi: 1453/5285; 1109 shelter (Rasuwa 805). 25-28 barish, Rasuwa naya casualty nahi.
